caption: The drawing shows a square pattern with a beige background. The design consists of an outer border and an inner grid of floral arrangements. The border is made of intertwined green vines with evenly spaced pink and red flowers; the vines create a wavy, undulating appearance along all four edges. Inside the border, there are nine smaller squares arranged in a 3x3 grid. Each square contains four pink flowers with red centers, surrounded by curling green leaves and stems forming circular patterns. The flowers have multiple petals, and the green leaves are paired along the stems. The entire composition uses mainly green, pink, and red colors, with the patterns symmetrically and evenly distributed across the beige background. The outer area of the drawing, outside the main pattern, is unadorned beige.
title: Applique Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
